devices.title: Shelly Devices
devices.description: Discovered and manually added Shelly devices.
devices.empty: No devices yet. Run discovery, or add your first Shelly by its IP.
devices.deleteDescription: Remove {{name}} ({{address}}) from the registry? The device itself is not changed.

add.title: Add a device
add.description: Enter the device's IP address. We probe GET /shelly to detect its generation and model.
add.name: Name (optional)

password.title: Admin password
password.description: Set or change the admin password of {{name}} ({{address}}).
password.currentDescription: Required because this device already has authentication enabled.
password.newDescription: Protects the device's local web interface and API.

discovery.title: Discover devices
discovery.description: Listens for Shelly devices announcing over mDNS, then probes every address of a subnet. Everything found is added to the registry.
discovery.subnetDescription: Leave empty to scan the server's own networks. Private ranges only, /22 at most. Required when Attraccess runs in a container, since its network is not your LAN.
discovery.running: Probing addresses — a /24 takes a few seconds.
discovery.hint: Nothing answered GET /shelly. If Attraccess runs in a container, enter the subnet your devices are on — the container's own network is not your LAN.

info.title: Device info
info.auth: This device requires authentication. Enter its admin password to read protected info.
info.name: Name

firmware.description: Check for and install firmware updates on {{name}} ({{address}}).
firmware.installing: Installing the {{stage}} firmware{{version}}. The device reboots during the update and is offline for a moment — this page keeps checking.
firmware.timeout: The device did not report the expected firmware version within 5 minutes. Check it and re-check the firmware manually.

ble.title: Set up over Bluetooth
ble.description: Connect to a factory-reset Shelly from this browser, give it Wi-Fi and an admin password, and add it to Attraccess.

unsupported.title: Bluetooth is not available here
unsupported.noApi: This browser cannot use Web Bluetooth. Open Attraccess in Chrome or Edge on a desktop or Android device.
unsupported.insecure: Web Bluetooth only works on HTTPS pages or on localhost. Open Attraccess over HTTPS.
unsupported.alternatives: You can still add the device with “Add device” if you know its IP address, or use “Discover” once it is on your network.

start.intro: Stand next to the Shelly and make sure it is powered and factory reset. Works with Shelly Gen2, Gen3 and Gen4 devices. Gen1 devices cannot be set up over Bluetooth.
start.hint: Your browser opens a list of nearby Bluetooth devices. Pick the Shelly (its name starts with “Shelly”).

connect.title: Could not connect
connect.noRpcService: This device does not offer Shelly's Bluetooth RPC service. Gen1 devices never do. On some Gen2 firmware, enable “RPC over Bluetooth” in the device's web interface. Otherwise join it to Wi-Fi through its own access point, then use “Add device” or “Discover”.
connect.adapterOff: Bluetooth is switched off or missing on this computer. Switch it on and try again.
connect.linkLost: The Bluetooth connection could not be established. Move closer to the device and try again.
connect.generic: Could not talk to the device over Bluetooth.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi network
wifi.description: Pick the 2.4 GHz network the device should join.
wifi.scanning: Scanning for networks — this can take several seconds…
wifi.scanFailed: The device could not scan for networks. Enter the network name yourself.
wifi.scanFailedProtected: The device could not scan for networks. If it already has an admin password, enter it below and press “Scan again”, or enter the network name yourself.
wifi.passwordManualDescription: Leave empty for an open network.
wifi.none: The device did not see any networks.

admin.newDescription: Required. It protects the device before it joins the network. The username is “admin”.
admin.currentDescription: This device already has an admin password. It is used to authenticate over Bluetooth and is not changed.

name.label: Name (optional)
name.description: Shown in Attraccess. Defaults to the Bluetooth name of the device.

disable.label: Switch off Bluetooth on the device after setup
disable.description: Keep it on only if you use the device as a BLU or BTHome gateway. While Bluetooth is on, anyone nearby can try to connect.

validation.ssid: Choose or enter a Wi-Fi network.

ble.secretsNote: Wi-Fi and admin passwords go from this browser straight to the device over Bluetooth. They are not sent to Attraccess and not stored.

steps.join: Wait for the device to join the network

failure.title: Setup failed at “{{step}}”
failure.wrongPassword: The device rejected the admin password. Check it and try again.
failure.linkLost: The Bluetooth connection was lost. Move closer to the device and start over. If the device already joined Wi-Fi, use “Discover” to add it.
failure.joinTimeout: The device did not get an IP address within 60 seconds (last status: {{status}}). Check the password, and that the network is 2.4 GHz — Shelly devices cannot join 5 GHz networks.
failure.timeout: The device did not answer over Bluetooth in time. Move closer and try again.
failure.rpc: The device refused the request: {{method}} returned “{{message}}” (code {{code}}).
failure.registerFailed: The device is on the network, but Attraccess could not add it ({{message}}). Use “Discover” or “Add device” to add it.
failure.registerFailedNoDetail: The device is on the network, but Attraccess could not add it. Use “Discover” or “Add device” to add it.
failure.generic: Something went wrong while talking to the device.

result.title: Device set up
result.name: Name
result.bluetoothRefused: The device refused to switch Bluetooth off. It is set up and registered; switch Bluetooth off in the device's web interface if you want to.
result.bluetoothUnknown: The device did not confirm that Bluetooth is off. It is set up and registered; check Bluetooth in the device's web interface.
result.alreadyRegistered: A device with the IP {{ip}} is already registered in Attraccess, so nothing was added.
result.restart: Wi-Fi is set and the device is restarting. Once it is online, use “Discover” (or “Add device”) to add it. Bluetooth is left on.
